text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a religious debate on "religion and science" at the occasion of the holy month of Ramadan.
- President asked newly named Justice Minister Abdallah Kallel to go on with the project of judicial reform to adapt Tunisia's legislation to the opening up of the economy.
- Killing of Algerian top trade union leader Abdelhak Benhamouda: President Ben Ali sent a message of condolences to Algerian President Zeroual.
- Good start for exports of dates, olive oil and citrus this season.
- The ministry of tourism annoucned the nomination of Fakhreddine Messai as chairman of the Office National du Tourisme Tunisien.
